profile.reading: Per EdgeConneX own Chicago page, this facility, CHI02, publishes 7 MW of N plus 1 total planned capacity, with an initial Phase 1 of 3 MW N plus 1 and 282,000 square feet of raised floor for tenants. EdgeConneX describes the Chicago campus as 25 miles from downtown Chicago and 6 miles from O Hare International Airport. The site carries HIPAA, PCI-DSS, SOC 2 Type 2, and ISO 27001 compliance.

reading.body:
EdgeConneX CHI02 sits in Elk Grove Village, Illinois, and publishes one hard technical figure: 282,000 square feet of technical space. Critically, the operator has not published a megawatt figure for this campus, which means no IT load is on record here. Without a power number, any translation into racks or accelerators would be speculation, and this site does not speculate. The absence of a published megawatt figure also means the campus does not contribute to Illinois's total of 236 MW drawn from six facilities that do publish power, and it ranks seventh by published megawatts in the state, which in practice means it ranks outside the cohort of six that have disclosed any number at all.

The 282,000 square feet of technical space is a substantial footprint. As a rough sense of scale, large hyperscale campuses commonly run between 150 and 300 watts per square foot of technical space at AI training densities, but applying any such ratio here requires an assumption about power density that the operator has not provided, so no rack or GPU estimate follows from that floor area alone. What the square footage does confirm is that this is not a small edge node. It is a large building capable of hosting significant infrastructure if powered accordingly, but whether it is powered accordingly is not published.

The four certifications, SOC 2 Type 2, PCI DSS, HIPAA, and ISO 27001, qualify the campus to host regulated workloads including payment card data, protected health information, and information security management systems subject to that standard. Those certifications do not determine AI suitability on their own, but they do signal that the facility has passed third-party audits for controls that many enterprise and healthcare AI customers require as a baseline. Illinois has 44 mapped facilities in total, and most publish no capacity figure, so CHI02 is representative of a common condition in this state: large, certified, and largely opaque on the power question that most determines AI scaling potential.
